استعبدوا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْبَدُوا (istaʕbadū) /is.taʕ.ba.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَعْبَدَ (istaʕbada)
# اُسْتُعْبِدُوا (ustuʕbidū) /us.tuʕ.bi.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْبَدَ (istaʕbada)
# اِسْتَعْبِدُوا (istaʕbidū) /is.taʕ.bi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْبَدَ (istaʕbada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
